key_insight: GAS-SCF uses Grover-style amplitude amplification to speed up self-consistent field optimization by quantumly favoring Fock states that improve the energy estimate.
engineering_relevance: It provides a baseline hybrid quantum chemistry workflow for comparing future structured optimizers like QAOA and DQI on SCF problems.
method: Build a quantum oracle using arithmetic to mark Fock states that lower the classical energy estimate.
Apply amplitude amplification to boost the probability of sampling marked states.
Use classical simulation on small examples and extend qubit-resource analysis to larger cases.
evidence_signal: The paper classically simulates three proof-of-concept examples up to 26 qubits and analyzes two larger systems, including O3 at 330 qubits.
watch_item: Chemically relevant performance will likely require large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum hardware, so near-term deployment is limited.
paper_title: Quantum-Accelerated Self-Consistent Field: A Hybrid Algorithm
